races.paceDynamic: Simon Pierre will attempt to lead from the front with Simba's Pride likely to track him closely, creating a moderate early gallop over this 1m trip at Thirsk. With most of the field carrying hold-up styles (Clonquest, My Ballyquinn, Mayflower Billy, Raja Charger) and Arc At Her being untested, the pace should be sustainable through the middle sections. The lack of confirmed pace pressers means Simon Pierre can dictate terms until the final 2-3 furlongs when the closers attempt their challenge. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with proven finishing kicks from mid-division, as the moderate pace will leave plenty in reserve for the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Simon Pierre maintains a steady gallop without early pressure from Simba's Pride
scenarios.body: The moderate tempo allows hold-up horses to get into contention turning for home, with Clonquest's proven finishing kick from Newcastle giving him the edge. Arc At Her could emerge as a significant threat if showing debut promise with her strong pedigree.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Simon Pierre and Simba's Pride work together early and maintain a solid gallop
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows both leaders to save energy for a sustained drive, with Simon Pierre's class edge from his Lincoln meeting run proving decisive. The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Benefits Improvers
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes stop-start with uncertain tempo
scenarios.body: The inconsistent gallop creates confusion in the field, allowing horses returning from breaks like My Ballyquinn or Simba's Pride to benefit from the chaotic rhythm. Fitness and adaptability become key factors over pure class.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Simon Pierre goes too slow early and gets swamped by multiple closers
scenarios.body: The pedestrian early sections turn this into a sprint finish where multiple hold-up horses converge simultaneously. Pure speed over the final furlong decides the outcome rather than tactical positioning.

watchPoints.text: Simon Pierre could get loose on the lead if Simba's Pride fails to track him closely enough through the early stages
Arc At Her represents the complete unknown factor with strong breeding that could produce a surprise debut performance
Clonquest's finishing kick will be crucial to time correctly given the likely moderate pace scenario
Simba's Pride faces a significant step up in trip from 5f to 1m after nearly a year off the track
The bottom three rated horses (Luscious Lil, Mayflower Billy, Raja Charger) all show consistent fading patterns in their recent form

races.paceDynamic: Tough Date will likely lead uncontested from the off, with Inferno and Bridgefoot Rambler providing token early company in a moderate pace setup. The lack of genuine speed means this becomes a test of who can quicken best from the back half of the field when the pace lifts approaching the final two furlongs. Hold-up horses like Bearish and Supreme Lillia get the perfect scenario to unleash their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours hold-up runners who can produce a sustained finish from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Tough Date leads unchallenged and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The pace will be too slow for the leaders to sustain their advantage when the hold-up horses unleash their finishing kicks. Bearish and Supreme Lillia get the perfect tactical setup to showcase their acceleration from the rear.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Press Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Inferno and Bridgefoot Rambler put genuine pressure on Tough Date early
scenarios.body: The increased pace will stretch the field and create a more honest gallop that could suit horses with tactical speed. Tough Date might find enough to hold on if the pace becomes too strong for the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Favours Class
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with no clear tempo being set
scenarios.body: The tactical nature will turn it into a sprint finish where pure class tells over running style. Bearish's superior form rating becomes the deciding factor in a bunch finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate Weak Field
scenarios.trigger: If none of the hold-up horses show the expected improvement from their breaks
scenarios.body: The modest early pace actually suits the leaders who can dictate terms throughout. Tough Date capitalizes on his recent racecourse experience against this limited opposition.

watchPoints.text: Tough Date could steal this if allowed to dictate fractions completely uncontested from the front
Bearish needs to overcome 161-day layoff but Ed Dunlop's runners often return race-fit despite poor stable form
Pepsea's market support will be crucial given his unraced status and expensive breeding background
Supreme Lillia showed ability on debut but significant regression second time suggests temperament or physical issues
Inferno's switch from all-weather to turf could unlock improvement after showing progression on artificial surface

races.paceDynamic: Pol Roger and Travis are the only confirmed front runners in this 13-runner field, setting up a contested early pace between two horses seeking to bounce back from poor recent form. With most of the field comprised of hold-up horses including Amidst The Chaos, Mariner, and Harswell Ruby, the early pace should be honest but not breakneck as the two leaders establish position. The large contingent of hold-up performers will create a cavalry charge from the back, but the honest gallop from the front two should play into the hands of horses that can sit handy and get first run on the closers. This tactical setup favours prominent racers and those hold-up horses with proven tactical speed like Jamaican Storm and Amidst The Chaos.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Two Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If Pol Roger and Travis set too strong a pace and tire in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The early leaders weaken dramatically allowing the hold-up brigade to sweep past them. Horses with proven finishing kicks like Amidst The Chaos and Harswell Ruby benefit most from the strong pace collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Front Runner Holds
scenarios.trigger: If either Pol Roger or Travis settles better than expected and conserves energy
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more measured allowing one of the leaders to kick clear when the hold-up horses are still organising their challenge. Travis looks the more likely given his recent consistent placings.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong throughout and the field becomes well strung out
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup but need to be produced with a perfectly timed run. Mariner and Volto Di Medusa have the class edge in this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Handy Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Copper And Five or Jamaican Storm can secure ideal positions just off the pace
scenarios.body: The prominent runners avoid the early battle but stay close enough to pounce when the pace-setters weaken. Their fitness and tactical positioning gives them the edge over the deeper held horses.

races.paceDynamic: Seacruiser and Scoville are both natural front-runners who will contest the early lead, with Seacruiser making his return after 561 days and Scoville having previously made all when winning by 14 lengths. Their clash will create an honest gallop through the middle sections, with Poet Master and Mount Athos likely to track just behind in prominent positions. The sustained pace should set up the race for horses that can stay on strongly, favoring prominent racers who can position close enough to strike and hold-up horses who thrive when the pace collapses in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Seacruiser or Scoville gets an uncontested lead and the pace becomes tactical.
scenarios.body: The winner gets first run on softer fractions and has too much left for the closers to reel in. This suits natural pace-setters who can control their own destiny and avoid traffic.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the two front-runners go too hard early and compromise each other.
scenarios.body: The honest gallop sets up perfectly for horses sitting just off the pace to sweep through with their finishing kick. Mount Athos and Poet Master can time their runs to perfection.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong and the leaders tie up badly.
scenarios.body: The strong gallop stretches the field and allows a patient ride to work to devastating effect. Darkness and Rhoscolyn get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners are taken on aggressively by other pace-forcers.
scenarios.body: The messy early fractions create a stop-start rhythm that suits versatile types who can quicken off any pace. Elarak's return to 7f and positive riding style becomes crucial.

races.paceDynamic: Pride Of Donegal will take this race by the scruff of the neck from the start, with no other confirmed front-runners to challenge his early dominance. Asmen Warrior and Roarin' Success will track him in second and third, but neither has the tactical speed to pressure the leader through the early stages. The two hold-up horses, Gibside and In The Breeze, will settle at the back and rely on the stamina test over this extended trip. This sets up perfectly for front-runners and prominent racers who can dictate terms without pace pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pride Makes All
scenarios.trigger: If Pride Of Donegal jumps cleanly and establishes an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: He can dictate a steady gallop that suits his stamina reserves, then quicken when it matters most down the home straight. The lack of pace pressure allows him to save enough energy for a decisive kick that the hold-up horses cannot match.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Asmen Warrior or Roarin' Success can stay close enough to the leader throughout
scenarios.body: They can pounce when Pride Of Donegal comes under pressure in the final two furlongs, using their tactical position to strike at the optimal moment. The sustained gallop will suit these middle-distance specialists better than the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too sedate and the race turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: In The Breeze and Gibside can use their closing kick to sweep past tiring front-runners in the final furlong. The tactical disadvantage becomes an advantage if the race lacks a true test of stamina.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Pride Of Donegal fails to fire or makes a tactical error early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no clear pace-setter, allowing any of the prominent racers to inherit the lead. This chaotic scenario opens the door for an opportunistic winner from the chasing pack.

races.paceDynamic: Miss Willows and Filey Beach are the confirmed front runners who will contest the early pace, with Angel Of England and Blackjack likely to sit prominently behind them. This creates an honest gallop over 7f at Thirsk, but nothing extreme with just two committed pace-setters in a 16-runner field. The majority of the field are hold-up horses who will look to come from off the pace in the final 2f. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and horses with tactical pace who can position close enough to the leaders without getting embroiled in the early battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Willows and Filey Beach don't go too hard early and set reasonable fractions
scenarios.body: The prominent horses like Angel Of England and Blackjack can track the leaders without being stretched, allowing them to kick when it matters. Hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up as the pace quickens entering the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Early Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Willows and Filey Beach engage in a fierce early battle and set a searching pace
scenarios.body: The pace-setters weaken significantly in the final furlong, opening the door for the large contingent of hold-up horses to finish strongly. Horses with proven finishing kicks benefit most from the strong early tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gains a soft lead and the early pace is moderate
scenarios.body: Miss Willows or Filey Beach can dictate terms and kick clear when the pace lifts, holding off the late challengers. The lack of early pressure allows the leader to save energy for a decisive move.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both pace-setters go off too fast and completely tie up in the final 2f
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole as multiple hold-up horses converge simultaneously. This creates a blanket finish where any of the closers can prevail depending on their final furlong acceleration.

races.paceDynamic: Maldevious is the only confirmed front-runner in this 16-runner field and will dictate terms from the rail without pressure, likely creating a sustainable tempo rather than a frantic gallop. The prominent runners Yorkshire Glory, Lord Abama, Mark's Choice and Belsito will track close behind, but none are aggressive pace-forcers who would challenge Maldevious early. This sets up a tactical race where the large field of hold-up horses including Juan Les Pins, Fiscal Policy, Great and Moonstone Boy will be relying on a strong finish from off the pace. The single uncontested leader creating a measured tempo over 6f at Thirsk strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick, rather than hold-up horses who need a stronger gallop to set up their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Maldevious gets his own way in front and sets fractions to suit
scenarios.body: The front-runner controls the race completely and has enough left to resist late challengers, with prominent trackers filling the places. This tactical scenario suits horses who can dictate or sit close to slow fractions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuine enough to set up the race for those tracking handy
scenarios.body: Yorkshire Glory or Mark's Choice can use their class advantage to outkick the leader in the final furlong, with other prominent runners benefiting from the ideal position. The measured pace still favours those close up rather than hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Finish Fast
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates enough pace pressure to make the race a true test
scenarios.body: Juan Les Pins, Fiscal Policy and Great get the strong gallop they need to unleash their finishing kicks from the back. The 16-runner field generates enough tempo to blunt the front-runners and set up a cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Maldevious goes too slowly and the race becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: The tactical nature becomes extreme and any horse with a turn of foot can win from any position. This creates chaos where class and condition matter more than running style, opening the door for outsiders.

watchPoints.text: Yorkshire Glory's all-weather winning streak may not translate to turf debut, making him vulnerable despite market support
Maldevious must prove he can lead effectively on debut for new yard after wind surgery and 141-day layoff
Mark's Choice typically needs his reappearance run but has won fresh before, so fitness is key unknown
Several runners including Lord Abama, Valentine Catcher and Belsito return from 4+ month breaks without recent form
The going remains genuinely good across all Thirsk races today, favouring those with proven form on similar surfaces
